senses.gloss:
r. 5th cl. (षध्नोति)
To wish to hurt or kill.

(उ) साधु r. 4th cl. (साध्यति)
1 To effect, to accomplish or complete.
2 To succeed; also साध.

(उ) साधु r. 4th cl. (साध्यति) (औ) साधौ r. 5th cl. (साध्नोति)
To finish, to perfect, to complete, or accomplish; also षाध.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wealthy, rich.
E.
स with, घन wealth.

n. (-नं)
1 Accomplishing, effecting.
2 Matter, materials, that of which any thing is composed or consists.
3 Thing, substance.
4 Means, expedient.
5 Instrument, agent.
6 Authority.
7 The premises leading to a conclusion.
8 Cause.
9 Going, motion.
10 Following.
11 Killing, destroying.
12 Obsequies, ceremonies observed after the death of a relative.
13 Drug, medicament.
14 Wealth.
15 An army.
16 The penis.
17 Friendship.
18 Enforcement of the delivery of any thing, especially juridically, as the infliction and levy of a fine, &c.
19 Killing metals, depriving them (especially mercury) by oxidation, &c. of their metallic properties, for medicinal or alchemical purposes.
20 Good works, or the observance of the moral and ceremonial parts of the Hindu religion, as secondary means of obtaining purity and emancipation.
21 Proof, substantiation.
E.
षाघ to accomplish, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
1 Like, equal, resembling.
2 Of the same sect or caste, performing like duties.
3 Of the same or similar properties.
E.
स for समान same, घर्म्म merit, practice, and अनिच् aff.

f. (-णी)
A wife, one married with religious rites.
E.
स with, (her husband,) घर्म्म duty, चारिणी who proceeds.

mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि)
Observing the same customs or laws.
f. (-र्म्मिणी)
A wife wedded according to the ritual of the Vedas.
E.
स same or with, घर्म्म virtue or duty, इनि aff.

f. (-वा)
A wife, whose husband is living.
E.
स for सह with, घव a husband.

m. (-धिः)
A name of AGNI or fire.
E.
स with, धा to have, aff. कि.

m. (-धिः)
An ox, a bull.
E.
षह to bear, Uṇādi aff. इसि, and ह changed to ध.

mfn. (-ध्र्यङ्-ध्रीची-ध्र्यक्)
Accompanying, going with, a companion.
f. (-ध्रीची)
A woman's female friend, a confidante.
E.
सध्रि substituted for सह with, अञ्च to go, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Completing, perfecting, finishing, who or what effects or completes.
E.
साघ to finish, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-शः)
Production or indicative of proof (in law).
2 Establishment of premises, leading to a conclusion.
E.
साधन proof, &c., and निर्द्देश pointing out.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Perfective, to be perfected, accomplished, proved.
E.
साध to complete, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
A beggar, a mendicant.
E.
षाध to accomplish, Uṇādi aff. झच्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Perfecting, accomplishing.
2 Purifying.
3 Proving.
4 Recovering, (as a debt.)
E.
षाध to accomplish, शतृ aff.

n. (-र्म्म्यं)
Community of duty, office, property, &c.
E.
सधर्म्म of one duty, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णी-णं)
1 Like, similar.
2 Common, belonging to all or many.
3 Generic.
n. (-णं)
1 A common rule or precept, one applicable to many persons or things.
2 A specific or generic character, one common to all the individuals of a species, or all the species of a genus, &c.
f. (-णी)
A small bolt or bar.
E.
स for सह with, धारण a having, aff. अच्.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Common or universal duty, conduct to be observed by all castes or orders, as humanity, &c.
E.
साधारण general, and धर्म्म merit, duty.

f. (-स्त्री)
A whore.
E.
साधारण common, and स्त्री a woman.

n. (-ण्यं)
Community, universality.
E.
साधारण, and यञ् aff.

f. (-का)
Deep or sound sleep.
E.
साध to finish, aff. वुन्, fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Amerced, fined, punished by fine, (as the culprit.)
2 Awarded, (as the thing or fine.)
3 Awarded to or in favour of, (as the person to whom the fine is to be paid.)
4 Recovered, (as a debt.)
5 Accomplished, finished.
6 Discharged, fulfilled.
7 Conferred, bestowed, enabled to procure or effect.
E.
साध to accomplish, क्त aff., with इट् augment.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
One with supreme divinity.
E.
स with, अधिदैव superintending godhead.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Identified or one with elementary essence.
E.
स with, अधिभूत essential matter.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
One with the Supreme Being.
E.
स with, अधियज्ञ the object of sacrifice.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Very hard.
2 Very fit, proper, or right.
E.
साधु good, or considered as irregularly substituted for वाढ heavy, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative; also with इयसुन्, aff. साधीयस्.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Very right or proper.
2 Very hard or firm.
3 Very handsome.
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-धुः-धुः-ध्वी-धु)
1 Pleasing, beautiful.
2 Well-born, of honorable descent.
3 Right, fit, proper.
4 Good, virtuous, pious, pure.
5 Pure, classical, (as applied to language.)
6 Excellent, good.
7 Eminent.
m. (-धुः)
1 A Muni, a saint, a sage in general, one of subdued passions and contemplative habits.
2 A Jina, a deified saint venerated by the Jainas.
3 A usurer.
4 A derivative or inflected noun.
f. (-धुः or ध्वी)
A virtuous wife.
E.
साध to accomplish or perfect, Uṇādi aff. उण्.

m. (-कः)
A low or degraded tribe.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Well-born, of respectable family or descent.
E.
साधु the same, and ज born.

n. (-त्वं)
Goodness, correctness.
E.
त्व added to साधु; also with तल्, साधुता.

f. (-धीः)
A wife's or husband's mother.
E.
साधु pious, धा to have, affs. क and ङीष्.

n. (-ष्पं)
A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
साधु pure, पुष्प a flower.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Thinking one's self pure or virtuous.
E.
साधु, and मन to think, खश् aff.

m. (-ही)
A well trained horse.
E.
साधु agreeable, pleasing, वाह bearing, and इनि aff.

m. (-क्षः)
The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Cadamba.)
E.
साधु handsome or excellent, and वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-त्तः)
A virtuous or pious person.
n. (-त्तं)
Virtue, piety.
E.
साधु, and वृत्त practice.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
Virtuous.
f. (-त्तिः)
The institutes or moral and ritual observances of the Hindus.
E.
साधु excellent, वृत्ति practice.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Virtuous, righteous, wisely or virtuously inclined.
E.
साधु, and शील disposition.

n. (-त्वं)
Virtuous or righteous inclination or disposition.
E.
साधुशील, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, साधुशीलता.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Said or declared by the good.
E.
साधु, and उक्त said.

n. (-तं)
1 A flock of peacocks.
2 A stall, a shop.
3 An umbrella or parasol.
E.
स for सह with, आधृत held.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 To be perfected or accomplished.
2 Accomplishable, attainable.
3 To be inferred or concluded, (in logic.)
4 To be proved or demonstrated.
5 To be cured, curable, (in medicine.)
m. (-ध्यः)
An inferior deity or demigod, one of a class of twelve.
2 A deity in general.
3 The twenty-second astronomical Yoga.
n. (-ध्यं)
1 Accomplishment, perfection.
2 (In law,) The matter in debate, the thing to be proved.
3 (In logic,) The subject of the proposition.
E.
साध to accomplish, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being subjected to, or capable, or in course of proof.
2 Being in course of accomplishment.
3 Being proceeded against, (at law.)
E.
षाध to accomplish, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Comprehending that which is to be proved.
m. (-वान्)
(In law,) The party on whom rests the onus probandi.
E.
साध्य, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-नं)
Effecting what is to be or may be done, &c.
E.
साध्य, and साधन accomplishing.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Proof, conclusion, the establishing of that which was to be proved.
2 Completion, accomplishment, fulfilment.
E.
साध्य to be effected, &c., and सिद्धि perfection.

m. (-दः)
The fourth stage or division of a suit at law, judgment or decision.
E.
साध्य to be proved, सिद्धि conclusion, and पाद division.

m. (-वः)
1 Absence of the thing to be proved.
2 Absence of the subject of a proposition.
3 Impossibility of cure.
E.
साध्य, and अभाव non-existence.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unreproached, irreproachable.
E.
साधु the pious, and अनिन्दित not reproved.

n. (-सं)
Fear, terror.
E.
साधु a pious man, अस to throw or disperse, aff. अङ्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Virtuous.
E.
साधु, and आचार observance.
